author: MYKORL
quote:
The worst GTA in the series. The character design is dull and lacking and you can tell most of the old writers are not part of the development team.  30 fps is inexcusable approaching 2027, along with the amount of common bugs you encounter after multiple game delays. If it was called something else and not GTA VI, people would be calling this trash. 

Hopefully the multiplayer is better but i very much doubt it.

The critic reviews have clearly been paid.
